# Optio

> Optio is a free, open-source time-and-motion study app. Create study questions,
> record observations as you work, review sessions, and export results as CSV.

Optio runs in the browser on phones, tablets, and computers. No account is needed.
After the first visit finishes loading, it works offline and can be added to a
home screen. Studies stay in that browser; there is no backend, automatic backup,
or sync. Clearing browser data can erase studies. Export important results.

## App and documentation

- [Open Optio](https://mariusom.github.io/optio/): The canonical app URL to share.
- [Agent guide](https://mariusom.github.io/optio/agent-guide.md): Browser workflow, optional assistant access, consent, and tool limitations.
- [Source code](https://github.com/mariusom/optio): MIT-licensed implementation and contributor documentation.

## Agent access

Ordinary browser navigation is available without enabling assistant tools.
Experimental WebMCP tools require a compatible browser, an explicit query flag,
and the user's confirmation. They are disabled by default. Enabling them grants
read, change, and delete access, and the assistant provider may receive study
data. There is no public API server, OAuth service, or payment API.

The public documentation and discovery catalog contain no user study data.
